scope: Offline evidence audit of Mission 01 foreground gold-slice art. This does not launch Blender, Unreal, UAT, shader compilation, packaging, or rendering.

status_contract.production: A final asset has authoritative source, complete production gates, no unresolved required work, and accepted rendered plus packaged-performance evidence.
status_contract.blockout_proxy: An authored or imported candidate exists and is usable for composition or runtime wiring, but its own evidence explicitly identifies it as blockout, proxy, readiness-only, or non-final.
status_contract.missing: No candidate artifact exists for the required asset family.
status_contract.unverified: A non-proxy production-direction candidate exists, but one or more required acceptance gates remain unsupported.

master_plan.claim: Defines the Mission 01 gold-slice production and acceptance requirements.

asset_plan.claim: Defines the Blender/Fab/Unreal ownership split and the Mission 01 asset wave.

control_board.claim: Records L88 review and non-final rear-gunner staging.

l88_master_blend.claim: Governed L88 Blender blockout source containing aircraft, cockpit, crew staging, rifle, and Igla candidates.

l88_source_glb.claim: L88 blockout export imported by the validation/runtime hierarchy.

l88_import_delta.claim: Import delta passes but declares readiness-only, not AAA acceptance.

l88_assembly_contract.claim: Classifies 240 imported meshes into exterior, rear cockpit, crew, rifle, and Igla runtime bundles.

yak_runtime_build.claim: Runtime hierarchy passes while explicitly leaving final topology, PBR, skeletal crew, LOD, collision, visual, and performance acceptance outstanding.

m01_refinement_master.claim: Blender source for the refined Pathfinder, lighthouse, radar post, coast, road, and urban candidates.

m01_refinement_glb.claim: Shipping-direction GLB candidate for the M01 Wave 1 refinement.

m01_refinement_manifest.claim: Declares 20 refined static-mesh candidates and their semantic collision, material, pivot, and damage metadata.

m01_refinement_report.claim: Passes source/export checks but remains a candidate requiring Unreal visual and performance acceptance.

m01_unreal_audit.claim: Verifies import, placement, semantic collision setup, and Pathfinder bindings while leaving rendered and runtime-performance acceptance outstanding.

m01_pbr_report.claim: Verifies three hero texture candidates but explicitly claims no defensible high-to-low sculpt bake.

m01_pbr_manifest.claim: Records the Pathfinder, lighthouse, and radar-post texture package.

m01_environment_audit.claim: Environment persistence passes, while rendered GPU review remains pending.

m01_provenance_ledger.claim: Used-asset provenance passes with an explicit art backlog and unmanifested families.

proxy_markers: Source filenames contain MASTER_BLOCKOUT and silhouette_blockout.
L88 import receipt promotion is readiness_only_not_aaa_acceptance.
missing_requirements: Production Yak-52 exterior topology and real-world silhouette acceptance.
Final material slots, UVs, justified bake sources, decals, rivets, seams, and wear.
Production collision, LOD or Nanite policy, animation pivots, and gameplay sockets.
Rendered blind review and packaged performance acceptance.
asset_families.next_action: Author a production Yak-52 master exterior using the L88 envelope only as reference; preserve governed datums and replace the blockout topology.

asset_families.display_name: Rear cockpit and open sliding canopy
proxy_markers: Rear-cockpit meshes are contained in the L88 blockout source.
Runtime receipt leaves final topology, PBR, collision, and rendered acceptance outstanding.
Control-board passes describe subject-presence staging, not final cockpit acceptance.
missing_requirements: Production cockpit tub, sidewalls, instrument panel, seat, harness, padding, trim, rails, canopy bows, and sliding glass.
Pilot-safety geometry plus weapon, ADS-eye, occupant, canopy, and restraint sockets.
Final cockpit materials, glass response, labels, fasteners, wear, and close-range bake detail.
First-person rendered review and packaged ADS/fire performance acceptance.
asset_families.next_action: Build the rear cockpit in the same production Yak master so crew and weapon rigs inherit final dimensions and sockets.

asset_families.display_name: Rear-gunner arms, sleeves, and leather gloves
proxy_markers: The L88 contract classifies first- and third-person static-mesh staging bundles.
The runtime receipt explicitly leaves skeletal crew outstanding.
Control-board notes describe replaceable crew-part visual staging.
missing_requirements: Anatomically credible high-poly hands, fingers, wrist transition, sleeves, and leather glove construction.
Production retopology, skeletal rig, skin weights, deformation tests, and first-person LOD policy.
Rifle support-hand, trigger-hand, ADS, recoil, reload, Igla carry, lock, and launch poses.
Close-range material/bake validation and packaged animation/performance acceptance.
asset_families.next_action: After the cockpit datums are frozen, author one first-person skeletal arms-and-gloves rig that supports both rifle and Igla pose libraries.

proxy_markers: The 18-part rifle bundle comes from the L88 blockout export.
A handheld rifle cue passed subject-presence review, not final hero-weapon review.
No final high-to-low weapon bake or packaged visual acceptance is recorded.
missing_requirements: Production receiver, barrel, handguard, magazine, controls, sling interfaces, and mechanically aligned iron sights.
Final first-person UV density, high-to-low bakes, metal/polymer/wood or coating materials, markings, wear, and fouling.
Grip, support-hand, muzzle, casing, ADS-eye, recoil, and animation sockets.
Physical ADS alignment and fire-while-ADS packaged acceptance.
asset_families.next_action: Rebuild the rifle as a separate governed hero asset after the final hand positions and ADS eye are frozen.

proxy_markers: The eight-part Igla assembly is sourced from the L88 blockout export.
Control-board staging describes a stowed/swap visual assembly.
No final launcher/missile bake, animation, rendered, or packaged acceptance receipt exists.
missing_requirements: Production launcher tube, gripstock, optics, battery/coolant unit, controls, sight details, and missile.
Explicit front/rear orientation, launch socket, exhaust clearance, seeker axis, and projectile datum.
Final UVs, high-to-low bakes, materials, markings, wear, and animation-ready pivots.
Lock, launch, backblast-safe presentation, and packaged performance acceptance.
asset_families.next_action: Build the launcher and missile as separate governed assets against the frozen rear-gunner rig and cockpit safety envelope.

missing_requirements: Defensible high-to-low bake source or documented justification for the final close-range geometry/material route.
Rendered Unreal visual acceptance of body, four weak points, damaged state, and breakup pieces.
Packaged combat performance acceptance covering destruction and both weapon-resolution paths.
asset_families.next_action: Retain the governed weak-point and breakup contract; run the later visible Unreal review and packaged destruction gate before production promotion.

missing_requirements: Final high/low or justified Nanite source and landmark-detail bake acceptance.
Visible Unreal review under mission daylight, overcast, wet, night, and storm test lighting.
Route-distance LOD/Nanite, collision, and packaged performance acceptance.
asset_families.next_action: Keep the refined landmark candidate and close its visible-lighting, material, and packaged route-performance gates.

missing_requirements: Final high/low or justified Nanite source and close-range bake acceptance.
Visible Unreal review of radar materials, moving parts, defended-objective readability, and weather response.
Packaged route and objective-combat performance acceptance.
asset_families.next_action: Keep the refined radar candidate and close its animation/pivot, visible-material, and packaged objective-performance gates.

asset_families.display_name: M01 beach, dunes, seawall, promenade, road, and urban transition
missing_requirements: Final terrain/surface material acceptance, including macro/micro variation, wetness, shoreline blending, decals, grime, and repetition control.
Complete provenance for every used Fab/Quixel or third-party source; no unmanifested foreground family.
Visible GPU review proving grounded districts, stable scenery, correct water/land separation, and no foreground proxies.
Route HLOD/Nanite/streaming and packaged performance acceptance.
asset_families.next_action: Complete source/license binding and visible Unreal review before promoting the assembled coast beyond production-direction candidate.

summary.interpretation: The audit is internally complete, but no scoped family has final production acceptance.

next_serialized_blender_build.title: Production Yak-52 master exterior and rear cockpit
next_serialized_blender_build.reason: The final airframe, cockpit dimensions, canopy envelope, occupant datums, ADS eye, weapon sockets, and safety volumes are upstream dependencies for the first-person crew and both weapons.
required_outputs: Dimensioned production Blender master with real-world Yak-52 silhouette.
Separated exterior, propeller, canopy, cockpit, controls, seat, harness, trim, and glass objects.
Named pivots and sockets for pilot, rear gunner, ADS eye, rifle grips, rifle muzzle, Igla grips, Igla launch axis, canopy travel, and cockpit safety.
Production topology or documented Nanite strategy, UV sets, material IDs, bake cages or justified source route, and Unreal-scale validation.
Non-destructive export manifest and proof renders; no Unreal import until the offline source gate passes.
acceptance_before_unreal_import: Silhouette and dimensions pass reference review.
No blockout-named mesh is marked shipping-ready.
UV, material-slot, pivot, transform, naming, and non-manifold checks pass.
Crew and weapon datum contract is frozen and machine-readable.
